sentence: Tidy passes: At most 8 edits (merge, move under, possibly renamed, rename, create a parent for related topics, refile a thread), each with a one-line reason.
context:
Heading: Organizing suggestions
Previous paragraph: Topic divisions: When placement identifies a distinct lasting area beneath a populated first-level topic, Workstreams asks for a complete reviewed filing plan. Ask now also considers divisions explicitly. A plan must identify supported, independently assignable scopes, useful specificity, and a home for every stored assignment, including archived work. The classifier can conclude that no lasting division is supported. Only acceptance creates the child topics; a second-level topic cannot gain children.
Paragraph: Tidy passes: At most 8 edits (merge, move under, possibly renamed, rename, create a parent for related topics, refile a thread), each with a one-line reason. A move under a parent drops the words the names share: "Vercel Agent Code Review" moves under "Vercel Agent" as "Code Review". With organizing suggestions on, a pass runs after changes to topic definitions or visible root membership and filing settle. Checks are debounced by two seconds; titles and statuses alone do not start a pass. Applicable tidy edits waiting for review pause automatic passes; after a decision, changed work is assessed. Ask now runs splits and a pass right away, replacing pending tidy edits. A tidy pass sees at most 12 threads per topic and 12 Unfiled threads; it can propose thread moves only for the threads shown in that call.

sentence: Upload only this harness and the approved private inputs.
context:
Heading: Allocation and integration
Previous paragraph: upload takes a local file and absolute remote destination, writes mode 0600, and does not display content. exec runs a non-secret command on the original live session with a five-minute vendor timeout and prints its output. Only use commands whose output is safe. Never pass a secret in command arguments. Detached service commands must redirect their output privately and close inherited standard input.
Paragraph: Upload only this harness and the approved private inputs. Do not transfer a local BB data directory, user history, GitHub login, Pi auth file, SSH keys, or Vercel credentials. Install the runtime on control using runtime/install.mjs, then run runtime/launch.mjs with the public gateway origin. Start the gateway with that same BB_GATEWAY_ORIGIN, BB_CORE_PORT=38886, and BB_GATEWAY_PORT=8080; inject its owner-password file privately. Only port 8080 is exposed. BB core stays on loopback.

sentence: Limit: useBbNavigate has no way to open a window.
context:
Heading: Open a plugin page in a new BB window
Previous paragraph: Use case: Walkthrough's reading view should open in a BB window of its own, so it can sit on a second display beside the thread.
Paragraph: Limit: useBbNavigate has no way to open a window. BB's desktop app denies every window.open from an app window and hands http(s) URLs to shell.openExternal (apps/desktop/src/desktop-window-factory.ts), so the link lands in the system browser, and New window always loads the app root. A plugin cannot create a BB window at a route. The only plugin-owned route is a navPanel, which BB lists in the sidebar navigation, visible by default, so a page that exists to be shown on its own costs a sidebar row. Split panes can be started only by dragging a sidebar row.

sentence: Waiting threads (the agent reported Waiting on a subagent or timer, or analysis found the work still in progress) rank after every other thread, even read ones.
context:
Heading: Sidebar (Workstreams thread list)
Previous paragraph: Read Waiting threads
Paragraph: Waiting threads (the agent reported Waiting on a subagent or timer, or analysis found the work still in progress) rank after every other thread, even read ones. Up Next then trims from the bottom: threads not blocked on you leave, least urgent first, until 5 remain; read blocked threads leave until 10 remain; past that, only the 10 most recently active stay, whatever their tier. So Up Next always shows a few threads, grows only for threads blocked on you, and lists at most 10 on its own. Show N more lists the trimmed threads that are unread or blocked on you below the rest, and Show less collapses them; trimmed read threads not blocked on you stay in Recent and their workstreams. It re-ranks as recaps, read state, and activity change. The thread you have open keeps its row and place until you open another thread. Nested delegates do not appear as separate Up Next entries; find them in their workstream's thread tree.

sentence: Workers report results and blockers to the parent using bb thread tell.
context:
Heading: Workspace coordination
Previous paragraph: elegate_to_repo; workers receive the context tool. Delegation requires a repository, task name, task brief, and done criteria. It defaults to a Workforest task worktree branched from the member's clean, committed HEAD. Set setup: true to run Workforest setup. Distinct task names isolate concurrent work; repeating an identical recorded assignment returns its child rather than spawning another. checkout: "shared" attaches the member checkout only when no live BB thread is attached to it. Children inherit the coordinator's resolved execution settings, with accept-edits as the permission fallback.
Paragraph: Workers report results and blockers to the parent using bb thread tell. Coordinators inspect child output and coordinate explicit branch integration before cross-repository verification. Task worktrees are retained after failures and thread archival; Workforest owns deletion. Role instructions guide behavior, not filesystem permissions. Checkout conflict checks cover current BB threads; external tools can still access the same files.

sentence: Limit and evidence: public experimental_serverAccess grants contain { id, serverUrl, headers? }, not a trusted core principal.
context:
Heading: Provider-neutral authenticated ingress for user-owned server access
Previous paragraph: Use case: a local plugin opens an outbound tunnel to a user-owned relay; a user-owned gateway authenticates individually scoped/revocable machine access without a hosted BB account, while BB/database remain local
Paragraph: Limit and evidence: public experimental_serverAccess grants contain { id, serverUrl, headers? }, not a trusted core principal. Public server.loopbackBaseUrl reaches ordinary trusted-localhost APIs. In request context and host enrollment, local enrollment-key minting and remote machine/gate identity are distinct. Proxying remote requests into loopback does not preserve that distinction. The newer SDK's internal_DO_NOT_USE_openTunnelIngress is explicitly Connect-only, and its implementation verifies Connect assertions and marks requests remote. No supported external plugin API attaches a provider-neutral principal or cross-checks an access grant's host against the native daemon/enrollment credential. Core removal can also skip provider release if the plugin is unavailable: cloud grant expiry/startup reconciliation cannot rely solely on lifecycle callbacks. Grants have no native credential-refresh callback. Stable provider credentials can avoid replacement, but worker reconfiguration after rotation must be demonstrated: enrolled bootstrap does not automatically deliver new headers

sentence: Workaround: Workstreams records unanswered questions in its own SQLite database before requesting native input.
context:
Heading: Preserve pending user questions across plugin reloads
Previous paragraph: Limit: plugin-runtime.ts unload calls pendingInteractions.interruptPluginInteractions(id), marking interactions plugin-disposed. Detached tool results are dropped. ui.requestInput offers neither a durable request ID nor a way for a new plugin generation to adopt the request and its waiter. The server log confirms questions dropped at exactly the reload timestamp. Removing the abort signal cannot prevent plugin-owned interaction disposal
Paragraph: Workaround: Workstreams records unanswered questions in its own SQLite database before requesting native input. The composer restores orphaned cards after reload, retains partial input in per-tab session storage, and delivers recovered answers through threads.send as ordinary user messages. Recap enforcement stands aside while the durable question remains unresolved. Native waiting status and original tool-call continuity are not preserved; the frontend disappears briefly while its bundle reloads. Recovered delivery claims the record before sending to prevent concurrent-tab duplicates, but the SDK offers no idempotency key: a crash or ambiguous network failure during send cannot guarantee exactly-once delivery. This is recovery, not transparent native interaction persistence

sentence: Stateful UI rules also run through production headless interfaces: src/app/sidebar/upNextState.ts plans Up Next's selected-row anchor and expanded rows, and src/app/page/activityLoader.ts owns Activity's pagination and request invalidation.
context:
Heading: Tests and verification
Previous paragraph: ebar action tests use sidebar-action-fixture.tsx when broader list wiring is not under test; it still mounts the real ThreadList for snooze, menu, and group actions. Consolidated cases keep negative controls and cross-group states that make their assertions discriminating. Sidebar fixtures omit Up Next and Recent unless the case requests mountWithBands. Related gestures and display variants can share a mounted scenario; keep failure, cancellation, and ownership boundaries explicit. Ranking policy matrices belong in domain tests, with representative UI cases checking rendering and interactions.
Paragraph: Stateful UI rules also run through production headless interfaces: src/app/sidebar/upNextState.ts plans Up Next's selected-row anchor and expanded rows, and src/app/page/activityLoader.ts owns Activity's pagination and request invalidation. Their tests drive state changes and deferred responses without mounting a page. DOM tests cover the React boundary: selection and Snooze, pagination controls, filter changes, realtime refresh, and effect cleanup. The Activity wiring test supplies a small loader result; the headless tests exercise the real loader with full pages. Sidebar row presentation, count preferences, archive ancestry, band sorting, tree folding, and batch snooze membership run headlessly through src/app/sidebar/{presentation,rows}.ts. Grouping policy matrices live in tests/domain/{groups,nested-groups,project, empty-workstreams}.test.ts; sidebar integration tests keep representative rendering and interaction cases. Native row shortcuts, Archive, disclosure, and realtime preferences are tested on a single real row through the SDK harness, without mounting the whole sidebar. Keep these tests in npm test, not a separate fast suite.

sentence: Components are written as name(field: value, …) statements inside workstreams fences; one fence holds one or more of them.
context:
Heading: Upstream bb and the tomdale/bb fork
List introduction: Workstreams works on upstream bb (plugin SDK 0.6.5 or later): the recap tool, the docked recap card, the question card, the sidebar, Up Next, and the Workstreams page. With the tomdale/bb fork, which adds a message-block slot, you also get Structured replies:
Previous paragraph: Parsing and validation retain the structured information: comparisons, sequences, behavior changes, checks, delivery records, recommendations, and bounded groups. Checks and delivery stages can include evidence links. A reply's kind remains separate from whether its work is complete, ready for review, or waiting.
Paragraph: Components are written as name(field: value, …) statements inside workstreams fences; one fence holds one or more of them. Every argument is named, and values are static: "text", numbers, true, false, null, [lists], {key: value} objects, bare enum words such as check status, and, inside group, nested components. """…""" holds multi-line text; text containing a triple-backtick fence needs a four-backtick workstreams fence. Operators, templates, variables, and bindings are rejected. Field names, required fields, enums, and limits come from the same schemas that validate a component, and the signature lines in the agent instructions are generated from them.

sentence: Workaround: the banner reports each draft's text and identity to the plugin server as they change (draftIdentity), and the dispatch hook pairs a fresh first message with the reported draft of the same text, waiting up to 10 seconds for a report that arrives after the dispatch (ComposedDrafts).
context:
Heading: Attach plugin data to every submit of a composer
Previous paragraph: Limit: experimental_data reaches dispatch hooks only through the plugin's own composer.submit(options). A plugin cannot add data to a submit the user starts: BB's Enter key calls the prompt box's onSubmit directly (PromptBoxInternal.tsx submitPrompt), firing no form submit event, and the composer has no before-submit hook or standing submission data. The banner's capture-phase submit listener on form[data-promptbox] sees only send-button clicks, so a manually picked identity was lost on Enter.
Paragraph: Workaround: the banner reports each draft's text and identity to the plugin server as they change (draftIdentity), and the dispatch hook pairs a fresh first message with the reported draft of the same text, waiting up to 10 seconds for a report that arrives after the dispatch (ComposedDrafts). Identical drafts in two windows can pair with either thread, and the form listener still depends on BB's markup.

sentence: The instructions teach that strict form, but a component still renders when its writer's intent is clear: single, curly, or backtick quotes; unquoted text; missing or extra commas; = for :; positional arguments; names in another case, a common synonym, or a small misspelling that points at one field; enum words such as Passed, ok, or not tested; numbers and booleans written as text; a single value where a list belongs; a string for a step or evidence entry; unknown fields, which are dropped; indented """ text; nested groups, which flatten; and a Workstreams or workstream fence.
context:

Previous paragraph: ide workstreams fences; one fence holds one or more of them. Every argument is named, and values are static: "text", numbers, true, false, null, [lists], {key: value} objects, bare enum words such as check status, and, inside group, nested components. """…""" holds multi-line text; text containing a triple-backtick fence needs a four-backtick workstreams fence. Operators, templates, variables, and bindings are rejected. Field names, required fields, enums, and limits come from the same schemas that validate a component, and the signature lines in the agent instructions are generated from them.

sentence: Trace recording & redaction: Every Quick analysis, Full analysis, placement, category, split, and tidy model call records its redacted input, prompt, raw response, reasoning summary, parsed output, token usage, cost, duration, and applied outcome.
context:
Heading: Debug mode and observability
List introduction: Enabling Settings → Workstreams → Advanced → Debug mode turns on trace recording and unlocks diagnostic tools across the UI:
Paragraph: Trace recording & redaction: Every Quick analysis, Full analysis, placement, category, split, and tidy model call records its redacted input, prompt, raw response, reasoning summary, parsed output, token usage, cost, duration, and applied outcome. Common secret patterns (sk-…, ghp_…, github_pat_…, xoxb-…, Bearer …, and api_key/token/password/secret assignments) are masked before prompts reach a model or trace store. Redaction is best effort, not a security boundary; do not put secrets in requests or assume diagnostics are safe to share without inspection. Conversation excerpts go to your selected model provider under that provider's policies. Traces are retained for 7 days or 1,000 records and pruned automatically even after Debug mode is turned off.

sentence: Gallery browser scenarios share a file-scoped Vite server and browser, with at most two scenarios running concurrently.
context:
Heading: Tests and verification
Previous paragraph: t. Server fixtures use real, disposable SQLite databases with synchronous disk flushing disabled; they cover transactions, migrations, and reopening storage, not recovery after power loss. Fake worlds copy an empty current-schema image into each fresh database. Real migrations produce that image once per test module, and plugin installation still verifies the migration ledger. Migration and storage-boundary tests use createTestPluginHost to start from an empty database. Fixture tests compare the cloned schema and hashes with a fresh migration and check isolation, rollback, reopen, and cleanup.
Paragraph: Gallery browser scenarios share a file-scoped Vite server and browser, with at most two scenarios running concurrently. Each scenario owns a fresh browser context, so cookies, storage, viewport, and theme changes stay isolated.

sentence: The gallery includes foundations, a Primitives group, work identity, settings, overlays, recap and question playgrounds, and reply examples.
context:
Heading: Standalone design system gallery
Previous paragraph: by Vite to browse the Workstreams design system outside BB. The development-only app in gallery/ imports the plugin's actual components and vendored BB controls. It is separate from the plugin's Gallery view and is not registered or shipped in the plugin. Build a static copy with npm run gallery:build. It writes gallery/dist/index.html and gallery/dist/sidebar.html, each a single file with its script, styles, fonts, and icons inline, so you can open them directly from disk with no server. npm run build runs it after building the plugin, so the pages stay current whenever the plugin is rebuilt.
Paragraph: The gallery includes foundations, a Primitives group, work identity, settings, overlays, recap and question playgrounds, and reply examples. Its Sidebar playground opens a separate development-only page with side-by-side Trial and Current examples, configurable row treatments, and independent connecting lines for the Workstreams section, shared parents, workstreams, categories, and child threads. Trial starts with the plugin's sidebar defaults, drawn from its geometry, typography, and preferences; reset returns to those defaults. Sidebar width is a shared preview control because BB owns the actual width. Experimental treatments with no app counterpart keep their own settings. Line controls set visibility, width, color, indent, and spacing. Changes and expandable state can be shared in the URL; fragments from older playground settings URLs can be applied to this page. The examples use the plugin's thread rows and workstream names with local fixtures, while the alternative grouping and layout treatments are simulated. Topic and status colors use the playground's light and dark fixtures, not your live BB settings. Nothing writes to BB or ships in the plugin.

sentence: While categories exist, every arrival, departure, or substantive request that changes a root's work causes the classifier to reconsider the whole collection.
context:
Heading: Organization and categories
List introduction: Categories arrange rows inside a workstream without changing its topic, native section, or identity hue. Both the sidebar and phone Home show them. Any topic without children can have categories, at either topic depth. Sidebar category headings use a subdued version of the workstream color:
Previous paragraph: At 6 roots, the category classifier sees the whole collection and creates useful categories. It counts visible, non-archived, unsnoozed roots, including completed roots; delegates follow their root and do not count separately.
Paragraph: While categories exist, every arrival, departure, or substantive request that changes a root's work causes the classifier to reconsider the whole collection. Requests are assessed when dispatched, without waiting for Full analysis. It sees the current arrangement and should preserve it unless a change offers a meaningful organizational benefit. Cosmetic changes do not justify regrouping. There is no cooldown, periodic assessment, or separate incremental mode.

sentence: Limit and evidence: the environment provider's remove receives one environment, while environmentHasLiveThreads checks threads attached to that environment ID.
context:
Heading: Safe retirement of multi-checkout environments
Previous paragraph: Use case: retire a provider-created Workforest workspace after its last thread archives, without deleting a member checkout or task lane used by a different BB thread
Paragraph: Limit and evidence: the environment provider's remove receives one environment, while environmentHasLiveThreads checks threads attached to that environment ID. The plugin's delegated task lanes use separate unmanaged environments. BB's findEnvironmentPathClaim compares exact paths, not overlapping paths; a check of thread or environment lists before deletion cannot prevent a later attachment. Core runs .bb-env-teardown.sh for an owned path before invoking the provider's remove, so the provider cannot refuse that hook on a failed Workforest safety check

sentence: A topic holds threads or subtopics, never both.
context:
Heading: Core rules
Previous paragraph: Agent reports outrank fallback status. Structured questions (AskUserQuestion) and agent recaps (WorkstreamsRecap) take precedence over Full analysis for thread status, recap text, and needs you prompts. Full analysis supplies those fields only when the agent did not report.
Paragraph: A topic holds threads or subtopics, never both. Once a topic has subtopics, every thread in it is in one of them. Assignments, new subtopics, moves, and merges that would put threads beside subtopics are refused, whoever makes them; topic pickers list only topics without subtopics. Topic paths have at most two levels total. Adding children to a populated topic requires a reviewed filing plan for all stored assignments, including archived work, using meaningful lasting areas rather than a General or Other catch-all.

sentence: Drag a root thread to another workstream to set its Topic to that workstream's topic; its delegates follow it.
context:
Heading: Sidebar (Workstreams thread list)
Previous paragraph: Use the Sort workstreams menu to order workstreams by Name A–Z, Recent activity, or Manual order (drag headers within their tier).
Paragraph: Drag a root thread to another workstream to set its Topic to that workstream's topic; its delegates follow it. Drop on a row to place it before or after that root, or on a header to place it first, including a collapsed or recently emptied workstream. Drop in Unfiled to clear its topic. When the destination represents several topics, Workstreams uses the Placement model to choose an existing topic within that group. It shows Choosing a topic in the destination workstream… while choosing, then saves the choice as a manual topic. The same action works on a parent group's header, including groups whose topics list inline; when that header has no thread list of its own, the chosen subgroup's order applies. sentence: Record revoke intent durably before remote cleanup.
context:
Heading: Grant lifecycle and recovery
Previous paragraph: Retry acquire within an epoch returns the same grant ID and credential; abortion before return still leaves enough state for release(..., null). Availability is read-only and never acquires/provisions access.
Paragraph: Record revoke intent durably before remote cleanup. Deny at connector even if the relay/gateway is unreachable; queue remote reconciliation. Expiry is necessary because core cannot always call the provider on removal. Proposed default: a 24-hour provider-side access lease, renewed by the authenticated local control service only for still-active grants. Lease renewal does not change the credential returned to the daemon. Fail closed after missed renewal; an explicitly revoked epoch cannot renew. This lease protocol is not implemented by the reducer, and ServerAccessGrant has no native token rotation/refresh callback. Credential replacement therefore requires the supported repair flow, not an assumption that daemons receive new headers.

Local tests run the separable components in one Node test process with real sockets; independent OS-process behavior is not established.

sentence: There is no automatic snapshot cleanup.
context:
Heading: Use
Previous paragraph: install resolves the plugin, records what it found, and reloads the session so the new skills are available immediately (as /skill:<name> and to the model). Local plugin sources are checked automatically during Pi startup and reload, so edits in a local checkout are reflected without running install again. Unchanged skills reuse a completed snapshot without rewriting it or the registry. Remote plugin clones remain unchanged until an explicit install or update.
Paragraph: by a SHA-256 digest of captured file contents, paths, permissions, manifest inputs, and the namespace transformation version. A changed source produces a new snapshot, built privately and published by an atomic rename. Simultaneous startups can only discover complete snapshots. Existing snapshots are retained, including after removing a plugin, because running sessions may still read their files. There is no automatic snapshot cleanup.

sentence: Skills are loaded with a plugin-name prefix.
context:
Heading: Namespacing
Paragraph: Skills are loaded with a plugin-name prefix. A plugin named tdx that defines a refactoring skill is invoked as /skill:tdx-refactoring. This keeps plugin skills from colliding with your global skills (or another plugin's) that share a name — pi dedups skills by name, so without a prefix one would silently win.

sentence: Each installed plugin also has a stable discovery symlink at current/<plugin> under the loader home.
context:
Heading: Use
Previous paragraph: Snapshots are identified by a SHA-256 digest of captured file contents, paths, permissions, manifest inputs, and the namespace transformation version. A changed source produces a new snapshot, built privately and published by an atomic rename. Simultaneous startups can only discover complete snapshots. Existing snapshots are retained, including after removing a plugin, because running sessions may still read their files. There is no automatic snapshot cleanup.
Paragraph: Each installed plugin also has a stable discovery symlink at current/<plugin> under the loader home. Registry updates atomically replace this alias with a link to the complete current package snapshot; unchanged refreshes leave it untouched. Pi's extension still supplies immutable snapshot paths to sessions. External scanners can use the stable alias without knowing the current digest. Configure ~/.pi/agent/claude-plugins/current/tdx/skills in Pi's settings.json.skills to expose tdx to stock BB's Pi scanner. Pi deduplicates that alias and the extension's snapshot by canonical file path. Removing a plugin removes its alias but retains snapshots. A non-symlink at the alias path is a conflict and is never overwritten.

Paragraph: Settings: maximum nesting depth (default 2, range 1–10), maximum concurrent background runs per original thread (4, 1–32), and default timeout in seconds (1800, 0 for unlimited, maximum 86400). sentence: Do not read an existing local credential to obtain it.
context:
Heading: Authority and approvals
Previous paragraph: The parent owns cloud provisioning, public ingress, repo/key approval, live verification, and teardown. Never run install, checkout, sync-skills, or bootstrap on the control runtime or daily laptop. CLOUD_BB_WORKER=1 is a deliberate worker-only interlock, not a security sandbox. All installs use a new private root with its own HOME; the harness never reads or changes daily BB, Pi, Git, or npm auth/configuration. Never transfer the daily ~/.bb, Pi auth.json, SSH keys, account pools, or GitHub login.
Paragraph: strap --gateway-key-file reads it without printing it and adds AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY to the worker daemon environment. The daemon passes it to actual Pi. No key value appears in argv, generated command output, wrapper logs, machine provider inputs, or control-side machine environment settings. A fresh key restricted by provider budgets/models is preferable; the user controls which key is authorized. Do not read an existing local credential to obtain it.

Paragraph: y falls back to an existing bb-app on PATH when that download is denied. Before using installer mode, verify PATH selects the preinstalled pinned bb-app@0.48.1 and its sibling bb; the vendor fallback does not check their versions itself. Do not use the installer's unpinned registry fallback, which applies to 404 responses. Do not weaken gateway authentication or put an owner cookie in the bundle. Direct native enrollment and installer-backed enrollment are separate tested capabilities; successful direct enrollment alone does not prove the vendor installer ran.
